mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTRACT (ID, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_NAME, CONTRACT_TYPE, PARTY_A, PARTY_B, PARTY_B_CREDIT_CODE, CONTRACT_AMOUNT, AMOUNT_IN_WORDS, STATUS, VERSION_NO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.contractNo}, #{row.contractName}, #{row.contractType}, #{row.partyA}, #{row.partyB}, #{row.partyBCreditCode}, #{row.contractAmount}, #{row.amountInWords}, #{row.status}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO CONTRACT_LINE_ITEM (ID, CONTRACT_ID, ITEM_KEY, ITEM_NAME, BASIS, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, DECLARED_AMOUNT, SORT_NO) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.contractId}, #{row.itemKey}, #{row.itemName}, #{row.basis}, #{row.quantity}, #{row.unitPrice}, #{row.declaredAmount}, #{row.sortNo})

INSERT INTO CONTRACT_AWARD_NOTICE (ID, CONTRACT_ID, NOTICE_NO, PROJECT_NAME, WINNING_BIDDER, WINNING_BIDDER_CREDIT_CODE, WINNING_AMOUNT, WINNING_DATE, SOURCE_REF, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.contractId}, #{row.noticeNo}, #{row.projectName}, #{row.winningBidder}, #{row.winningBidderCreditCode}, #{row.winningAmount}, #{row.winningDate}, #{row.sourceRef}, #{row.createdAt})
